_rules: This public file stays EMPTY. Keep the real list in supporters.private.json (git-ignored) or pass --supporters: names in a public Git history can never be fully removed.

Only add people after their payment has succeeded and only as they asked in the PayPal note: nothing = anonymous (only raise 'anonymous' by 1), 'Show: name', 'Show: name + amount', 'Logo: name' (one payment of at least €100).
Show names exactly as written (first name or nickname is fine). Never add e-mail addresses or payment details.

Logos: convert with src/logo.py to a small WebP (max 320 x 128 pixels, shown at 160 x 64), put it in img/sponsors/ in the webroot, and set 'until' to 12 months after the payment date. After that date the logo disappears and the name stays. No links.
Remove anyone who asks (sponsors@luxyos.com) and build again. Newest first.
Examples: sponsors: {"name": "Bakkerij De Zon", "logo": "bakkerij-de-zon.webp", "amount": "€250", "until": "2027-11-16"}; supporters: {"name": "Sanne", "amount": "€25"} or {"name": "Mehmet"}.
